Column A arithmetic is self-consistent, but Column B is not: 535589.87 - 499883.37 = 35706.50 versus the Line 7 balance of 35686.50 (a 20.00 discrepancy, kept verbatim - the same 20.00 gap appears in the amended version, key 0370aecd).

contributions.detail: exact (65106.85 = 65106.85). p4 rows sum 32200.00, p5 rows sum 28800.00, p6 rows sum 4106.85; together 65106.85 = the attachment's own printed total = Summary Page line 1 Column A.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: The printed Schedule A (p3) and Schedule B (p7) carry only 'See Attached List' and no subtotal or total, and the attachments print no per-page subtotals - only one grand total per side. Both whole-side gates FIRED AND PASSED TO THE CENT (65106.85 and 34155.59). A THIRD, INDEPENDENT CROSS-GATE ALSO CLOSES: the 27 in-kind rows on the expenditure side sum to 4481.85, exactly equal to the 4 in-kind contribution rows on p5 (375.00) plus all 23 on p6 (4106.85) - so the two sides' in-kind blocks reconcile against each other item by item. FIELD-SHIFT SCREEN: every page has as many names as amounts, and the Occupation/Employer pairs that are populated match their donors.
itemized.escalation_note: pages 4-6 and 8-9 were classified from a 110 dpi contact pass and re-rendered at 230 dpi, which is the transcription source; the attachments are typed and crisp and no cell crop was needed. Both sides closing to the cent is the confirmation.
itemized.notes: A 9-PAGE FILING whose money is entirely on typed attachments. p3 is Schedule A and p7 is Schedule B, each carrying only the handwritten words 'See Attached List' (header boxes 'Corroon / 1-31-06', form pages 3 of 9 and 7 of 9); the itemization is on five typed spreadsheet pages self-labelled 'PAGE 4 OF 9' through 'PAGE 9 OF 9', headed CORROON / DATE OF REPORT 1/31/06. UNUSUALLY FOR THIS CORPUS, THE DONOR ADDRESSES ARE FULLY PRINTED AND NOT REDACTED, so donor_city and donor_state are populated on nearly every contribution row (street lines were discarded at read time per the privacy rule). Two donors are out of state (New York NY, Santa Ana CA, Los Angeles CA) and one - J P Morgan Chase & Co. PAC - prints a city and zip with NO state.
